player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.
player_prompt.commander_beta: Kota zo ti kota kamba Beta.

game_state.header_round:
=== Kolonɛl Blotto - Round {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Rounds Won - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

round_battle.winner_alpha: {message}Winner: Commander Alpha [Kozo zo ti bira so ayeke na ndo ni]
round_battle.winner_beta: {message}Winner: Commander Beta ti na ni so a soro lo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A yeke nzoni ti zia ni na yâ ti mbeti so ape. Sara kua na: A:5, B:10, C:5

invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: A lingbi a kangbi ni kue na azo so ayeke pëpe awato.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Zì na mbɛtɛ kɔza {num_total_units} zɛbɛ. Kɔza tɛ̂: {current_sum}
